g.text: In hardware at the shack: TX INH = PERMIT AND TX_EN, keying = KEY AND INH_ON (L3). A SAFE stop or shack FAULT inhibits at once, without the MCU.

g.text: Box link time-out while a permit is out: MCU_EN_N = 1 opens SAFE (inhibits every radio); K0 is not released by firmware (F13). R1 uses the PTT loop (T4).
